key.name: window-parallax
key.description: The strength of the parallax effect of windows.

key.name: last-first-gap
key.description: Add a gap between last and first workspace.

key.name: allow-workspace-looping
key.description: Allow workspace navigation to wrap from the last visible workspace to the first and vice versa.

key.name: do-explode
key.description: Explode the cube on vertical rotations.

key.name: per-monitor-perspective
key.description: Tweak the projection matrices for better multi-monitor support.

key.name: background-panorama
key.description: The texture used for the skybox.

key.name: edge-switch-pressure
key.description: The amount of pressure required to switch workspaces when dragging a window.

key.name: mouse-rotation-speed
key.description: A multiplier for the desktop cube rotation when dragged.

key.name: horizontal-workspace-input
key.description: Use horizontal dragging, workspace swipe tracking, and edge switching where Desktop Cube owns the spatial model. The Overview always honors this preference; ordinary desktop switching honors it only while Desktop Cube's desktop animation is enabled.

key.name: enable-desktop-workspace-cube-animation
key.description: Use Desktop Cube's 3D transform when switching workspaces outside the overview. Disable to keep GNOME or V-Shell's native desktop workspace transition.

key.name: enable-desktop-dragging
key.description: Desktop: Rotate the cube with the left mouse button.

key.name: enable-panel-dragging
key.description: Panel: Rotate the cube with the left mouse button.

key.name: enable-desktop-edge-switch
key.description: Switch workspaces when dragging a window over the desktop's edge.

key.name: enable-overview-dragging
key.description: Overview: Rotate the cube with the left mouse button.

key.name: enable-overview-edge-switch
key.description: Switch workspaces when dragging a window over the overview's edge.

key.name: workpace-separation
key.description: The pixel gap between adjacent workspaces.

key.name: horizontal-stretch
key.description: The widening factor which ensures that cube sides are visible from the front.

key.name: hide-empty-workspace
key.description: Hide the trailing empty workspace from the overview cube when dynamic workspaces are enabled.

key.name: hide-wallpaper
key.description: Hide per-workspace wallpaper faces in the overview so another extension can own the background.

key.name: active-workpace-opacity
key.description: The opacity of the front facing workspace.

key.name: inactive-workpace-opacity
key.description: The opacity of the cube sides.
